title: 雞排飲料店
question:
雞排飲料店販賣雞排與珍珠奶茶，每個盒子最多可以裝5塊雞排，每個紙架最多能放4杯珍珠奶茶。
給定每日訂單的數量與資訊，且每筆訂單會分開裝袋，計算該日使用盒子與紙架的總數量。

test_case.note: 本日有4筆訂單，第一筆訂單訂購10塊雞排、15杯珍珠奶茶，需要2個紙盒與4個紙架，依此類推。共需2+7+10+20，共39個紙盒，以及4+8+7+25，共44個紙架。

en.title: Chicken and Tea Shop
en.question:
A shop sells fried chicken and milk tea. One box holds 5 pieces of chicken. One cup holder holds 4 cups of tea.
Input the number of orders and each order. Each order is packed alone. Output how many boxes and cup holders the shop uses today.

test_case.note: 4 orders today. Order 1: 10 chicken and 15 teas. It needs 2 boxes and 4 cup holders, and so on. Boxes: 2+7+10+20 = 39. Cup holders: 4+8+7+25 = 44.
